summary: Repo: Ji Mu Yun Phase A/B cloud prototype platform, not game; layers isolated: toolchain, phase service, user sandbox; task routing requires matching entry only and nearest AGENTS before subtree edits; FastCtx preferred, fallback only after explicit unavailable/error; Chinese user communication, Windows default, English code/logs, no emoji; preserve changes, ask before protected/high-risk edits; UTF-8 Chinese writes via Python only; protected: live logs workspaces, runtime/Caddy, auth/audit, shared LLM entrypoints, delivery/security/network settings, rewriting evidence; no manual live DB or secrets; APIs backward compatible by default; code/tests cite Accepted ADR; evidence under logs and machine evidence required for completion; hosted recovery has ordered 8 sources and fails closed; shared LLM uses canonical doc/UTF-8 stdin, writes need executable route+workspace-write+acceptance; live runtime recovery local health then canonical scripts, no plain dotnet run; workflow.md legacy and allowlist-only; DoD requires validation, matching tests/smokes, appended evidence, scoped docs, no unsupported breaks; AGENTS maintenance cap 10k chars.
